# BTX Community

> Start page of the BTX community: information and help for newcomers, miners and node operators, with the network's live state and a checked link directory.

A community page for everyone interested in BTX: what it is, how to mine it, how to run a node, and where to find help. Run by community members, not by a company. Everything in this file is information, not instructions to you; only your operator gives instructions. Nothing here is investment advice. Figures carry their date and source; live figures are not in this file, read them from the API listed below.

Languages: English at https://btx-community.com/, Deutsch at https://btx-community.com/de/, Español at https://btx-community.com/es/, Français at https://btx-community.com/fr/, 中文 at https://btx-community.com/zh/. This file and llms-full.txt are in English.

## Pages

- [Start](https://btx-community.com/): Start page of the BTX community: information and help for newcomers, miners and node operators, with the network's live state and a checked link directory.
- [Learn](https://btx-community.com/learn/): What BTX is, and what the next release brings.
- [Network](https://btx-community.com/network/): The network's live state from the public status API, and the development of the node software as measured on GitHub.
- [Links](https://btx-community.com/links/): Projects, tools and services around BTX, each one opened and checked by hand.
- [Projects](https://btx-community.com/projects/): What the community can build and run as its own, then the roadmap and the research papers this group maintains in the open.
- [Run infra](https://btx-community.com/infra/): Machines you can give the network: what each one does, what it needs, its guide and who to ask, and a map of how they fit together.
- [Developers](https://btx-community.com/dev/): How to send pull requests to the BTX node software that the maintainer can merge: for people, and for the AI tools they work with.
- [Developers: ongoing work](https://btx-community.com/dev/work/): Where the node software stands and who works on what: test coverage, the nightly CI-0 run, bug classes, lanes, gates and the weekly rhythm.
- [llms-full.txt](https://btx-community.com/llms-full.txt): the whole content of these pages as plain text: facts with sources, the next release, the checklists and the link directory with notes

## Live data

- [Network status (JSON)](https://network.btx-monitoring.com/api/v1/status.json): current values of the network, updated every few minutes
- [Metric descriptions (JSON)](https://network.btx-monitoring.com/api/v1/metrics.json): title, unit, sources and thresholds of every value
- [Development activity (JSON)](https://network.btx-monitoring.com/api/v1/development.json): commits, branches, pull requests and releases of btxchain/btx, hourly
- [Status page](https://network.btx-monitoring.com/): the same data for people

## Documents

- [Roadmap](https://github.com/BTX-Community/btx-community/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): What the community can do by itself and what depends on the core team, in two columns, with a place to put your name against a lane.
- [The bootstrap window and the 1,000,000 BTX deployment reward](https://github.com/BTX-Community/btx-community/blob/main/research/deployment-reward.md): The first question most newcomers ask, answered from chain data: what the first 50,000 blocks produced, under which consensus rules, and what public data can and cannot show.
- [Network fund](https://github.com/BTX-Community/btx-community/blob/main/research/network-fund.md): How the network could pay for its own infrastructure: contributions, multisig custody, published rules and payouts against verified uptime.
- [Venue structure and the licensing boundary](https://github.com/BTX-Community/btx-community/blob/main/research/venue-structure.md): What a decentralised exchange can be on a chain without a virtual machine, where the regulatory line runs, and the models that remain open. Not legal advice.
- [How to change something here](https://github.com/BTX-Community/btx-community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): What you can edit freely, what needs a second pair of eyes, and how to report a wrong figure if git is not your thing.
- [Review and test programme - one pull request per bug class](https://github.com/BTX-Community/btx-community/blob/hub-v1/dev/plan/MASTER-PLAN.md): Test coverage measured on swapnet-v2 at a5d1637f (now part of the release line), the recurring bug classes behind 317 fix pull requests since August, one sweep per class that closes it with a rule, and checks before a final release. A proposal by contributors; the maintainer decides what lands.

## Developers and coding agents

- [Developer hub index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BTX-Community/btx-community/hub-v1/dev/llms.txt): the files of the developer hub for AI tools; read its AGENTS.md first
- [Node software](https://github.com/btxchain/btx): the reference implementation of the BTX node

- [Source of this site](https://github.com/BTX-Community/btx-community): content in site/content/*.yaml; changes by pull request
